y-m-09-03.material: Hajun ya ce, “Daga gida zuwa makaranta 1 km 200 m ne, daga makaranta zuwa ɗakin karatu kuma 800 m. Saboda haka daga gida zuwa ɗakin karatu 2 km ne!” Har yanzu ba ka ga taswira ba. y-m-09-03.s.s1.o.b: Yanayin da ake nufin tsawon idan ɗakin karatu yana kan hanya ɗaya tsakanin gida da makaranta

y-m-09-03.s.s1.o.c: Yanayin da ake nufin tsawon hanyar daga gida ta cikin makaranta har zuwa ɗakin karatu

y-m-09-04.title: Hasashen nauyin apple guda da ma'aunin sikeli
y-m-09-04.topic: Nauyi (g) da nemo iyaka ta kwatanta a sikeli
y-m-09-04.goal: Ko da ba za ka iya sanin ainihin ƙima ba, faɗi iyakar nauyi daga sakamakon kwatantawa, rage iyakar da sabbin lura, sannan ka yi tunanin iyakar kayan aikin da kake da su wajen ƙara takaita ta.
y-m-09-04.material:
Ka sa apple a kwanon sikeli ɗaya, nauyoyi kuma a ɗayan domin kwatantawa. Gefen mafi nauyi yana sauka; idan nauyoyin sun yi daidai, sikeli yana daidaita. Akwai nauyoyi da dama kowanne 50 g, 100 g, 200 g, da 500 g. A ɗauka akwai apple da dama masu nauyi daidai, kuma nauyin apple 1 cikakkiyar lamba ce a g.
Lura 1: apple 1 da nauyoyi 200 g guda biyu → gefen apple ya sauka.
Lura 2: apple 1 da nauyin 500 g guda ɗaya → gefen nauyin ya sauka.

y-m-09-06.goal: Koyi sharuɗɗan ƙa'idar rarrabawa da ke ba da sakamako iri ɗaya ko wanene ya rarraba; duba yadda sakamakon ke canzawa idan aka canza adadin da ke cikin ƙa'ida, sannan ka sake rubuta ƙa'ida marar fayyacewa a sarari.
y-m-09-06.material:

Littafi 1: labari, shafuka 64 / 2: kimiyya, 120 / 3: ilimin zamantakewa, 48 / 4: labari, 150 / 5: kimiyya, 200 / 6: tatsuniyoyi, 36 / 7: kimiyya, 88 / 8: labari, 96 / 9: littafin diary, 24 / 10: lissafi, 130.
Kana son amfani da ƙa'ida da za ta ba da sakamako iri ɗaya ko da ɗalibai ukun da ke kula da jera littattafan sun canza.

y-m-09-13.s.s2.prompt: Domin rubuta 'yawancin ɗalibai sun zaɓi pizza', aƙalla ɗalibai nawa ne dole su zaɓa?
y-m-09-13.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo rabin adadin ɗalibai 30 ka kwatanta da masu zaɓar pizza.
y-m-09-13.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi wasu adadin ɗalibai kamar 9, 12, 15, 20 da 25 ka raba su zuwa adadin da ya dace a kira 'mafi yawa' da wanda bai dace ba.
y-m-09-13.s.s2.o.a: 9 ya isa, domin shi ne mafi yawa.
y-m-09-13.s.s2.r.a: Wannan tunani ya ɗauki 'mafi yawa' da 'yawancin su' a matsayin ma'ana ɗaya.
y-m-09-13.s.s2.r.b: Idan rabi daidai ne, sauran ma rabi ne, saboda haka bai kai 'mafi yawa' ba.
y-m-09-13.s.s2.o.c: Dole ya zama 21 ko fiye. Ina ganin ya kamata ya zama 7 cikin 10.
y-m-09-13.s.s2.r.c: Wannan ya karanta 'mafi yawa' da tsauraran ma'ana. Muhimmin abu shi ne ya gane dole ya zarce rabin sosai.
y-m-09-13.s.s2.o.d: Dole ya zama 16 ko fiye. Dole ya zarce rabin 30.
y-m-09-13.s.s2.r.d: Wannan ya ɗauki rabi a matsayin ma'auni ya duba ko adadin ya fi haka.
y-m-09-13.s.s2.explain: Yawanci ana amfani da 'mafi yawa' idan ya zarce rabin a fili. Ga ɗalibai 30, dole ne ya zama 16 ko fiye domin ya fi rabin. Haka kuma za a iya amfani da ma'auni mafi tsauri na 21 ko fiye. Ko ta yaya, 9 bai isa ba.
y-m-09-13.s.s2.acc.0: Yana da kyau a fassara 'mafi yawa' da ma'ana mafi tsauri. Maganar cewa dole ya zarce rabin sosai iri ɗaya ce.
y-m-09-13.s.s3.prompt: Sake rubuta layi na 3 da gaskiyar da jadawali ya nuna kawai. Ka rubuta cikin kalmomi masu sauƙi da ƙaramin ɗalibin aji na 1 zai fahimta ba tare da ruɗewa ba.
y-m-09-13.s.s3.hint.0: Haɗa cikin jimlar adadin ɗaliban da suka zaɓi pizza da masu sauran abinci daga jadawali.
y-m-09-13.s.s3.hint.1: Maimakon 'mafi yawa', canza zuwa furucin da ke nuna shi da lambobi.
y-m-09-13.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Ɗaliban da suka zaɓi pizza su ne ...
y-m-09-13.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Za ka iya samun kowace lamba a jimlarka a cikin jadawali?
y-m-09-13.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Akwai sauran kalma kamar 'mafi yawa' da ta wuce bayanin jadawali?
y-m-09-13.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Kalmomin suna da sauƙin karantawa ga ƙaramin ɗalibin aji na 1 ma?

y-m-09-11.title: Za mu iya sanin wanda ya yi nasara yayin da ake ci gaba da ƙirga ƙuri'u?
y-m-09-11.topic: Yaushe za a yanke sakamako yayin da bayanai ke ƙaruwa
y-m-09-11.goal: Koyi cewa ba za a iya yanke sakamako daga ɓangaren bayanan da aka ƙirga kaɗai ba, sannan fahimci cewa yin tunanin ko sauran bayanai za su iya sauya matsayi yana taimakawa gano lokacin da za a iya yanke shi.
y-m-09-11.material: A taron aji mun kaɗa ƙuri'a domin zaɓar dabbar wakilin ajinmu. Masu takara uku ne: zomo, kunkuru, da sparrow, ɗalibai 30 kuma sun kaɗa ƙuri'a. Kowa ya zaɓi guda ɗaya, babu ƙuri'ar da ba ta inganta ba. Malami tana buɗe ƙuri'u ɗaya bayan ɗaya ta ƙirga, tana sanar da sakamako lokaci-lokaci. Wanda ya fi ƙuri'u zai zama dabbar wakili.
y-m-09-11.thinking.0: Tantance fannin abin da bayanan yanzu ke ba ka damar faɗa
y-m-09-11.thinking.1: Gyara hukuncinka idan sabon bayani ya zo
y-m-09-11.thinking.2: Bayyana sharuɗɗan da ake buƙata domin yanke sakamako
